sentence: The company decided to phase ___ the old product line gradually.
explanation: El phrasal verb <phase out> significa eliminar gradualmente.
tip: The company is gradually eliminating the old product line.

sentence: We need to iron ___ the details before signing the contract.
explanation: El phrasal verb <iron out> significa resolver problemas o dificultades.
tip: Resolve the details — remove the wrinkles in the plan.

sentence: The manager tried to play ___ the severity of the issue.
explanation: El phrasal verb <play down> significa minimizar la importancia de algo.
tip: The manager tried to minimize the severity.

sentence: She was passed ___ for promotion despite her qualifications.
explanation: El phrasal verb <pass over> significa ignorar a alguien para una oportunidad.
tip: She was ignored for the promotion — they skipped her.

sentence: The detective pieced ___ the evidence to solve the case.
explanation: El phrasal verb <piece together> significa reconstruir algo a partir de fragmentos.
tip: The detective reconstructed the evidence bit by bit.

sentence: They had to scale ___ operations due to budget cuts.
explanation: El phrasal verb <scale back> significa reducir el tamaño o alcance de algo.
tip: They reduced the size of operations due to budget cuts.

sentence: The new policy was brought ___ to improve efficiency.
explanation: El phrasal verb <bring in> significa introducir algo nuevo.
tip: A new policy was introduced to improve efficiency.

sentence: He was let ___ when the company downsized.
explanation: El phrasal verb <let go> significa despedir a alguien de forma diplomática.
tip: He was dismissed diplomatically when the company downsized.

sentence: The team rallied ___ their captain after the defeat.
explanation: El phrasal verb <rally around> significa unirse para apoyar a alguien.
tip: The team united to support their captain.

sentence: She stumbled ___ an interesting article while researching.
explanation: El phrasal verb <stumble upon> significa encontrar algo por casualidad.
tip: She found an article by accident while researching.

sentence: The negotiations fell ___ at the last minute.
explanation: El phrasal verb <fall through> significa fracasar o no concretarse.
tip: The negotiations failed — they didn't materialize.

sentence: We need to factor ___ the cost of transportation.
explanation: El phrasal verb <factor in> significa incluir algo en un cálculo o plan.
tip: Include the transportation cost in the calculation.

sentence: The CEO stepped ___ after the scandal.
explanation: El phrasal verb <step down> significa renunciar a un cargo.
tip: The CEO resigned from his position after the scandal.

sentence: They managed to fend ___ the hostile takeover.
explanation: El phrasal verb <fend off> significa defenderse de un ataque o amenaza.
tip: They defended against the hostile takeover attempt.

sentence: The project was held ___ by regulatory issues.
explanation: El phrasal verb <hold up> significa retrasar o demorar.
tip: The project was delayed by regulatory issues.

sentence: The committee drew ___ a list of recommendations.
explanation: El phrasal verb <draw up> significa preparar o redactar un documento.
tip: The committee prepared a list of recommendations.

sentence: The old regulations were done ___ with last year.
explanation: El phrasal verb <do away with> significa abolir o eliminar.
tip: The old regulations were abolished last year.

sentence: She was taken ___ by the unexpected generosity.
explanation: El phrasal verb <take aback> significa sorprender o desconcertar.
tip: She was surprised by the unexpected generosity.

sentence: He glossed ___ the controversial aspects of the report.
explanation: El phrasal verb <gloss over> significa tratar superficialmente algo problemático.
tip: He treated the controversial aspects superficially — which particle completes "gloss ___"?

sentence: The team pulled ___ a remarkable victory.
explanation: El phrasal verb <pull off> significa lograr algo difícil.
tip: The team achieved a remarkable victory against the odds.

sentence: The outcome hinges ___ a single decision.
explanation: El phrasal verb <hinge on> significa depender de algo.
tip: Partícula de <hinge>: depender de algo

sentence: The board continues to grapple ___ the crisis.
explanation: El phrasal verb <grapple with> significa lidiar con un tema complejo.
tip: Partícula de <grapple>: lidiar con un tema complejo

sentence: The critic singled ___ one performance for praise.
explanation: El phrasal verb <single out> significa seleccionar de un grupo.
tip: Partícula de <single>: seleccionar de un grupo

sentence: The speech touched ___ several sensitive topics.
explanation: El phrasal verb <touch on> significa mencionar brevemente.
tip: Partícula de <touch>: mencionar brevemente

sentence: The report calls ___ urgent action.
explanation: El phrasal verb <call for> significa exigir o requerir algo.
tip: Partícula de <call>: exigir o requerir algo

sentence: Investigators have not ruled ___ foul play.
explanation: El phrasal verb <rule out> significa descartar una posibilidad.
tip: Partícula de <rule>: descartar una posibilidad

sentence: The results bear ___ our initial hypothesis.
explanation: El phrasal verb <bear out> significa confirmar o corroborar.
tip: Partícula de <bear>: confirmar o corroborar

sentence: Officials promised to look ___ the allegations.
explanation: El phrasal verb <look into> significa investigar algo.
tip: Partícula de <look>: investigar algo

sentence: The jury needs to weigh ___ all the evidence.
explanation: El phrasal verb <weigh up> significa sopesar cuidadosamente.
tip: Partícula de <weigh>: sopesar cuidadosamente

sentence: The judges narrowed ___ the shortlist to five names.
explanation: El phrasal verb <narrow down> significa reducir opciones.
tip: Partícula de <narrow>: reducir opciones
